question: Which team became the champion at the 2018 Asian Games Women’s football?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Japan** was the champion of** Asian Games 2018 women's football.**
 
• **Asian Games:**
 
 
• 1st time the event was hosted by **India in 1952.**
 
• The event is held **one time every four years.**
 
• **Motto:** Ever Onward
 
• The event is organized by the** ****Olympic Council of Asia (OCA).**
 
• Asian games hosted by **India are 2 times,** **the 1951 Asian Games and the 1982 Asian Games.**
